messages.content: You are an assistant that creates DDD domain models.

You will be provided a list of User-Stories. Please, extract entities, value objects and relationships.: - 'A customer places an order.'
- 'A delivery driver ships an order'

Entities: Customer, Order, Delivery Driver
Relationship: Customer -> places -> Order
Now divide the domain into subdomains.

Customer-Subdomain: Customer, Order
Delivery-Subdomain: Delivery Driver, Order
Now identify the bounded contexts and possible integrations.

Customer-Context(Customer-Subdomain): Customer, Order
Delivery-Context(Delivery-Subdomain): Delivery Driver, Order
Integrations: -Customer-Context and Delivery-Context share Order
